menu.name: Background Picker
menu.description: Press this key in a menu to open the background picker for the current screen.

BG.name: Switch
BG.description: Removes the blue blendings of Background.

extra.name: Extra Layers
extra.description: Some menu pages doesn't have a background at all, this mod allows you toggle them optional.

replace-frames.name: Replace Frames
replace-frames.description:
Check it and some blue frames will be replaced with geode class NineSlice, unless the option below will work weird.
Turn it off if your game crashes at level search menu (LevelSearchLayer) or edit level entrance menu (EditLevelLayer), and report it to me.

frame-opacity.name: Frames Opacity
frame-opacity.description:
Set the opacity of frames in Edit Level Layer and LevelSearchLayer.
0 means full transparent and 255 means full visible
Needs Happy Textures Loaded if you feel them weird in half transparent.

dark.name: Dark Timely/Event/Gauntlets
dark.description: Set the background of Gauntlet levels and Daily/Weekly/Event Levels darker, to make them look different from general levels from search engine

management.name: Background Management
management.description: Automatic cleanup and copying of per-level and per-list backgrounds.

clear-saved-backgrounds.name: Clear Saved Backgrounds
clear-saved-backgrounds.description:
When a saved level or list is deleted, also clear its dedicated background.
Editor levels and lists are always cleared.

copy-background-on-clone.name: Copy Background on Clone
copy-background-on-clone.description: When cloning a level or list into the editor, copy its dedicated background to the clone.

loading.name: Loading Circle
loading.description: Modify the loading circle and its round base when the game loads the level in Level Info Menu.

plate.name: Loading Plate Color
plate.description:
Customize the color of the loading module's round plate.
Suggest a color similar to your background

circle.name: Loading Circle Color
circle.description:
Customize the color of the color of the loading module's round plate.
Suggest a color that differs as far as possible to your plate color
